creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen in the Mac mini's run log on 2026-10-21: codex queue was still running at the doorbell's 5 s patience 10 times, all on a loaded machine, and each wake was typed instead. None produced a duplicate, but each costs the session its command route after the second time. Consider a longer patience for the command itself, or measuring what codex queue spends its time on under load.
title: codex queue outlasts its 5 s patience on a loaded machine
